observation.visible_scene: A woman in a cream button-up shirt sits at a wooden tea table, facing the camera, with a red circular tray holding three small white cups directly in front of her. To her left is a larger clay teapot on a warmer; to her right are two cylindrical tea tins (pink and yellow-green). The background is a wall of shelves densely packed with reddish-brown clay teapots. A circular logo sits top-right, and vertical Chinese characters '好了喝茶' appear on the right edge partway through the clip. A small lavalier mic is clipped to her collar.
visible_changes: At the start the woman holds a small red clay teapot aloft in her right hand, tilted as if finishing a pour, positioned above the tray.
Over the first ~0.3 s the teapot and her right hand descend steadily toward the tray.
Around t=0.33 s the vertical text '好了喝茶' fades in on the right and remains visible for the rest of the clip.
By t≈0.4–0.5 s the teapot is lowered to tray level and becomes occluded by the cups and tray rim; her right hand then rests near the tray edge.
From roughly t=0.5 s to t=1.7 s her right hand stays resting at the tray, her gaze directed down at the cups, with only minor head and posture shifts (a largely static interval).

From about t=1.7 s onward her right hand lifts off the tray and moves into an open-palm gesturing motion, rising and spreading as she appears to speak; this hand gesture continues and varies through the final frame.
The camera framing and background shelves stay fixed throughout; no object other than the teapot and her right hand shows clear displacement.
outside_clip_unknowns: What preceded the clip (how the teapot was filled or lifted) and the exact final resting place of the teapot once it is occluded are not shown.
Whether the gesture leads to picking up a cup or any further action is not visible.
The content of her speech is unknown.
uncertain_details: Any slight overall darkening toward the last frames may be lighting/exposure rather than a real change; uncertain.
Whether the teapot is set on the tray or on the table behind it cannot be confirmed because it is occluded by the cups.
Small apparent shifts in the background are likely compression noise, not camera motion; camera movement is treated as absent but not fully verifiable.
